title: aiops-platform production dependency license allowlist
description: Licenses approved for production dependencies. Add new licenses here only after recording the decision in an ADR. The deployment contract test rejects any license not on this list.
reviewPolicy: Licenses in reviewRequiredLicenses block the CI gate until a maintainer records an ADR-driven exception. The fast gate runs the license allowlist contract test against docs/supply-chain/dependency-licenses.md and docs/security/license-allowlist.json.
